catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Local name of the catalog to add to. Its repository must accept changes from this grid.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: GUID of the project holding the node.

workflow_id.title: Workflow Id
workflow_id.description: GUID of the workflow holding the node.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: GUID of the node to add.

catalog_slug.title: Catalog Slug
catalog_slug.description: Name to store it under in the catalog. Defaults to one derived from the node's name.

node_type_id.title: Node Type Id
node_type_id.description: Node type id to give it. Prefixed with the catalog's own if it isn't already. Defaults to one derived from the slug.

include_samples.title: Include Samples
include_samples.description: Whether to ship the node's sample messages. Off by default - a sample is a message someone captured to test against, so on a live grid it is real traffic.

overwrite.title: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Whether to replace a template the catalog already has under this name. Without it, an existing name is a 409 rather than a silent overwrite.

version.title: Version
version.description: Release version to publish it as, e.g. '1.2.0'. Required: a subscriber picks between versions, and refuses an update whose files changed without the version moving. Replacing an adapter that already declares one needs a higher version.

message.title: Message
message.description: Release notes for this version - what changed and why. Becomes the commit subject, which is what a subscriber sees beside the version when choosing which release to move a node to.
